answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 39 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 220 fakes must lock 8580 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. Without comet the panel is blind, without quartz the farm is free, and without hollow nobody can prove what happened.
